item.title: Looking back 2025 | Alex Borg: Enthusiasm surges but gravitas lags
item.description: Alex Borg’s first 100 days as Opposition leader have been marked by something the Nationalist Party has not experienced in over a decade—a surge in enthusiasm among supporters and a perceptible closing of the trust deficit with the Labour leader

item.title: The sermon from the dinner table
item.description: Often, the discussion was about the good food, the excellent wine, the labrador that puked on the carpet, the time the children spend on their smart phone, the assessments at schools, the university lecturers who did not turn up, the wrong medical diagnosis, the friends who were separating, the last holiday, the new electric car and the limited series on Netflix.

item.title: Looking Back 2025 | How the Maksar gang trial exposed Malta’s darkest gangland chapter
item.description: The trial began on 24 April, more than four years after the arrests. Over six weeks, jurors heard testimony from 157 witnesses, reviewed CCTV footage, phone data, autopsy evidence and crime-scene reconstruction

item.title: Trump, Zelenskyy say progress made in Ukraine peace talks, but territory remains sticking point
item.description: Donald Trump and Volodymyr Zelenskyy say talks in Florida have delivered major progress towards ending the Ukraine war, but deep divisions over territory and security guarantees continue to cloud prospects for a final deal

item.title: Parts of Upper Barrakka have been cemented over, but don’t panic just yet...
item.description: The works are part of a solution to deal with water seepage damaging the Combined War HQ underneath, according to Fondazzjoni Wirt Artna’s executive chairman

item.title: Unprecedented increase in pushbacks from Malta’s SAR zone
item.description: Malta Migration Archive records 242 distress calls in first six months of the year • Libyan coast guard allowed into SAR at least 16 times

item.title: Campaigners release interactive map showing significance of Manoel Island
item.description: The map categorises the island’s features into archaeological and built heritage, terrestrial and marine biodiversity, and social elements such as collective memories associated with specific locations on the island

item.title: Smokers caught outside of designated zones in Golden Bay, Ramla l-Ħamra face €150 fines
item.description: The measure, announced last September, will allow authorities to fine smokers €150 if they smoke outside of designated smoking areas

item.title: Cold, cloudy start to the new year with isolated showers expected
item.description: Mostly cloudy skies, isolated showers and a sharp drop in temperatures are expected to mark the end of the year and the start of 2026, with a brief cold snap giving way to milder conditions by the weekend

item.title: Looking back 2025 | Israeli drone attack exposed Malta’s defence weaknesses
item.description: There was one incident in May 2025, which brought home the stark truth that neutrality on its own is not the magical cloak that shields Malta from calamity. A drone attack on the humanitarian vessel Conscience, operated by the Freedom Flotilla Coalition, exposed Malta’s vulnerability to potential threats by ill-meaning actors
